ns2:course.label: Italian Culture
ns2:course.description: Introduction to factors that have shaped present-day Italy; basic concepts contributing to understanding its present social and cultural development; taught in Italian. Prerequisite: ITAL 200 or ITAL 220, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ITAL 200 or ITAL 220, or consent of instructor.
